settings.hero_heading: Honest hair care. No miracle promises.
settings.hero_lead: Elaren makes a pumpkin seed oil scalp serum for people dealing with thinning hair. This page is everything we think you should know before you buy: what's in it, what it does, how long it takes, and what happens if it doesn't work for you.
settings.story_text:
Hair thinning is stressful, and the industry that sells solutions for it is full of exaggerated before-and-afters and fine print. We built Elaren around one ingredient with published research behind it, a routine that takes two minutes a night, and a guarantee that puts the risk on us instead of you.

We would rather tell you upfront who this won't work for than take your money and hope you don't ask for it back.

settings.title: One hero ingredient
settings.text: Pumpkin seed oil, chosen because it has been studied for hair loss, not because it's trending.

settings.title: All-natural formula
settings.text: No prescription actives and no harsh synthetics. The full ingredient list is on the product page.

settings.title: Realistic timelines
settings.text: We say 90 days because that's what it takes. Anyone promising two weeks is selling something else.

settings.title: The risk is on us
settings.text: A 30-day money-back guarantee. If it doesn't work for you, you get a full refund.

settings.label: How you use it
settings.value: Massage 1–2ml into a dry or towel-dried scalp every evening. Leave it on, don't rinse.

settings.label: When you'll notice
settings.value: Less shedding around week two, fine new growth around day 30, full results at day 90 with daily use.

settings.label: Guarantee
settings.value: 30 days. Full refund if you're not happy. No forms, no hassle.

settings.label: Questions
settings.value: A real person answers every message through the contact page.
